title: heuchera parviflora var. typica
intro: Heuchera parviflora var. typica, commonly known as the Alumroot, is a species of flowering plant in the saxifrage family (Saxifragaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and as an antidote for various poisons. The therapeutic actions of Heuchera parviflora var. typica include being an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
